title: BINI looks forward to ‘bittersweet’ final stop of ‘Signals’ World Tour in Taiwan
summary: With excitement and a touch of sadness, P-pop group BINI is set to wrap up its “Signals” World Tour in Taiwan, marking the final stop of its international concert series.
